candidate_formula: decision_own_drawdown minus opening known_drawdown, both on same own-state path and completed minute; opening drawdown separately in matched control
hypothesis: deeper own intraday drawdown reduces marginal fee-net five-session SOXL value relative to SOXX; candidate SOXL minus SOXX standardized coefficient on added feature must be negative
clock: score all source-valid completed-minute intentions t after09:47 parent open; feature receipt assumed t+1, next-bar fill t+2; use fixed raw-share order contract, never future funded mask as model input
training_maturity: label_available_at strictly before first2021 evaluation decision; no model or scaler sees later labels
excluded_terminal: last four2022 source days have no mature five-session terminal and are reported separately
model: two-head SimpleImputer(median,add_indicator=True)->StandardScaler->Ridge(alpha=1.0) for both control and candidate, four total fits, each training trade_date total sample weight1; no tuning
action_rule: for each evaluation day scan every eligible completed minute in chronological order, first minute with max(predicted soxl_value,predicted soxx_value)>0 triggers fixed-share SOXL or SOXX argmax, otherwise HOLD; one event/day local information screen, not a full five-session portfolio account
ablation: on the same trained candidate set own_drawdown_change=0 at inference to isolate direct feature transmission; also compare separately fitted control

uncertainty.metric: daily candidate-minus-control chosen local fee-net value including HOLD zeros

stop: Any source/hash/clock/label maturity/intent grouping/DatasetH or fee/order status mismatch stops. If fixed information gates fail, close this feature version without sign, threshold, year, window, alpha or model-capacity rescue; no 2023+ account.
action_tie_rule: at first positive score, choose SOXL only if its score is strictly greater than SOXX; exact tie chooses SOXX
